resources.string: Pick a server before Roblox opens.
Chooses a server from the public server list so Roblox does not drop you into a random one.
When you launch a game, Voidstrap reads the public server list and picks the server with the best reported ping and frame rate. It never signs in to Roblox.
Joining a server reporting %1$d ms ping.
Joining the best server we found.
No server matched, letting Roblox choose.
